'''Franciscus''' is a prideful Fisalia member and Chief Musician for the [[Order of the Deep]] who appears outside of the [[Cathedral of Mercury]]. It is later revealed his haughty behavior is a guise to hide his insecurity and guilt. After confessing to Rover, he is now more calm and polite.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Near the Vox Sancti during the Day)
:'''Franciscus:''' Nah. The tuning is flat... Might as well send it back to the "dock" for remodeling.
:'''Franciscus:''' Huh? Who's there listening in? Are you trying to steal my tuning (Echo tuning) skills?
:{{DIcon}} Who are you?
:{{DIcon}} Woah, am I being blackmailed?
:'''Franciscus:''' Do you not know who I am?
:'''Franciscus:''' Franciscus of Fisalia, chief musician of the Order, a one-in-a-million musical genius, with all Vox Sancti under my command!
:{{DIcon}} Oh.
:{{DIcon}} Oh, wow.
:'''Franciscus:''' You little uncultured- Oh, calm yourself Franciscus. Must keep it together for the honor of the Fisalia family...
----
;(Near the Confession Room at Night)
:'''Franciscus:''' Levito, oh... Levito...
:'''Franciscus:''' You were a true genius. And me? A mere mediocrity... a petty person even. I betrayed you...
:'''Franciscus:''' Huh? Who's there?
:{{DIcon}} How much did you drink?
:{{DIcon}} I didn't hear anything...
:'''Franciscus:''' ...Never mind. Friend, if you have a moment, could you indulge me in a brief confession?
:'''Franciscus:''' Do you know Levito? He was once the Order's lead musician.
:'''Franciscus:''' I saw him as my primary rival for the chief musician position and went head to head against him on every matter.
:'''Franciscus:''' To ensure I got the spot, I publicly disparaged his work. I stooped so low as to spread rumors that his work broke the Order's doctrines. All the slandering I did... They worked. Led to his downfall.
:'''Franciscus:''' I did these things because I was simply jealous of his talent. I couldn't compose such beautiful pieces, nor conduct the Vox Sancti to perform in such perfect unity...
:'''Franciscus:''' To this day, I still cannot surpass him.
:'''Franciscus:''' Then words came suddenly one day that he boarded the Pilgrim's Sail. I never heard from him again... only later did I learn the appalling truth of the pilgrimage.
:'''Franciscus:''' If anything happened to Levito during his pilgrimage, my part in this shall not be pardoned...
:{{DIcon}} You should say these words to Levito yourself.
:'''Franciscus:''' If I could, I would tell him in person of my remorse...
:'''Franciscus:''' Every night, I repent and punish myself with unbearable guilt. But when daylight comes, I put on my mask again.
:'''Franciscus:''' Thank you for listening. As you can see, my arrogance... is just a facet of my self-loathing and guilt...
:'''Franciscus:''' I fear my secret being revealed, yet my heart can't stop whispering it in the night...
:'''Franciscus:''' This guilt... it's nearly crushing me...
----
;(After confession Near the Vox Sancti during the Day)
:'''Franciscus:''' It's you. I'm  currently tuning these Vox Sancti.
:'''Franciscus:''' Composing hymns, tuning the Echoes, and conducting the Vox Sancti ensemble to perform the piece flawlessly-these are the duties of the chief musician.
:'''Franciscus:''' Vox Sancti are sacred species. Only the most pure and solemn hymns are worthy of their divine sounds.
:'''Franciscus:''' But I still can't fully command them... only Levito could manage that.
:'''Franciscus:''' Why is it... where lies the difference between us?
----
;(After Confession Near the Confession Room at Night)
:'''Franciscus:''' Thank you for listening. This guilt... it's nearly crushing me...
{{Dialogue End}}
